french_tuple: [verse number, 1-based token ordinal, 0-based Unicode code-point start, exclusive end] in verse reading text without notes/markup, trimmed. Apostrophes and internal hyphens retained.

relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 67 verses reread in both pinned texts; the repeated narrative and speech were treated separately.
notes: Gen 24:1–2: age and household seniority expressions grouped.
Gen 24:5,10–12: following, possession in the hand and prayer for a successful encounter retained as contextual idioms.
Gen 24:22–29: weights, proper names and possessive existence constructions preserve original IDs; supplied measures and pronouns contextual.
Gen 24:43–44: the opening of the answer is moved to the preceding French verse; the cross-verse relation is retained.
Gen 24:48–50,57: fidelity, refusal to speak good or evil, and consultation idioms grouped.
Gen 24:61–67: following, return and consolation after loss retain the original occurrences; explicit French Rebecca at v67 is contextual.
editorial_review.limitations: Both passes performed by the same editor; no independent dictionary-sense verification; publication checks deferred.
